previous_statement: For n<=m, the standard zero-corner inclusion M_n tensor S_P into M_m tensor S_P is isometric by the operator-space axioms in def-hcb-datum, and h_m intertwines it with the corresponding isometric target inclusion because h_m is the entrywise amplification. The infimum over the larger domain is therefore no greater: a_m<=a_n, equivalently a_n>=a_m.
new_statement: Corrected conditional and audit conclusion. Fix n<=m. If the domain zero-corner map i:M_n tensor S_P -> M_m tensor S_P and the corresponding target zero-corner map j are isometries and h_m composed with i equals j composed with h_n, then a_m<=a_n. However, the exact allowed definitions and the two permitted upstream lemmas do not supply these three hypotheses. Hence the unconditional matrix-size monotonicity a_n>=a_m asserted previously is not established in this workspace, and this node cannot support that clause of parent 1.3 without an additional allowed matrix-norm/amplification input.
